title: Computer Vision Training Suite
tagline: Toolkit for YOLOv8 training, augmentation & benchmarking
intro: A modular Python toolkit to accelerate dataset prep, augmentation, and training with YOLOv8.
summary: Included dataset preparation, automated augmentations, YAML configs, and benchmarking tools for consistent experiments. Cancelled in 2024-06.

sections.title: Description
sections.body: Python-based suite supporting YOLOv8 projects with dataset prep, augmentation, YAML configs, and benchmarking.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Reduce iteration cycles in model training/testing with reusable scripts and tools.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Authored modular dataset scripts, configured training setups, and implemented benchmarking pipelines.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Enabled consistent, faster model experiments across datasets.
